description: PANNs: Large-Scale Pretrained Audio Neural Networks for Audio Pattern Recognition. CNN audio tagging models pretrained on AudioSet (527 classes including dog_bark, cat, meow, animal vocalizations).
Efficient CNNs for Audio Tagging. Provides AudioSet pre-trained models ready for downstream training and extraction of audio embeddings. MobileNetV3-based efficient architectures.

Offline AI-powered video analysis tool with object detection (YOLO), image captioning (BLIP), speech transcription (Whisper), audio event detection (PANNs), and AI-generated summaries. PANNs can detect animal/dog/cat sounds.
A Python wrapper for Tadarida-D: A Toolbox for Animal Detection on Acoustic Recordings. Specifically designed for bioacoustics and animal sound detection in the wild.
Babysit dog via slow-updating webcam and audio peak levels (barks). Monitors dog barking through audio peak detection.

CNN-based environmental sound classification using UrbanSound8K dataset (10 classes: air_conditioner, car_horn, children_playing, dog_bark, drilling, engine_idling, gun_shot, jackhammer, siren, street_music). Detection of dog bark in urban settings.
Audio classification project with UrbanSound8k dataset. Contains 8732 labeled sound excerpts including dog_bark class for urban sound event detection.
AI/ML project that classifies dog bark sounds into emotions (happy, sad, alert, normal) using audio feature extraction and machine learning.
Dog Mood Prediction using deep learning to classify dog sounds (barking, whining, growling) into moods like happy, sad, or hungry. Uses TensorFlow and YAMNet.

AI-powered environmental sound classification system that identifies urban sounds (dog bark, siren, drilling, etc.) from audio files using MFCC feature extraction and machine learning. Includes Streamlit web app.
Global AI Hub Deep Learning Bootcamp graduation project. UrbanSound8K classification (10 classes including dog_bark) using deep learning.
A real-time audio classifier focused on detecting my neighbours and my dog's barks. Practical dog bark detection system.
CNN-based environmental sound classification using Mel spectrograms. Classifies sounds like car horns, screams, and dog barks.
General audio classifier for ambient noises from urban environments like sirens, traffic, construction, and dog bark. Introduction to DSP and audio classification.

Research-ready implementation of Sound Event Detection using deep learning techniques. Identifies and classifies specific sounds within audio streams, such as detecting dog barking, car horns, or doorbell ringing.

AI-powered environmental sound detection web app using CNN and Streamlit. Classifies audio events like sirens, dog barks, and drilling with real-time predictions and safety alerts. Integrated with Gemini API.
Dog-first local audio event monitor, redesigned from Woofalytics. Uses YAMNet for audio event detection focused on dog monitoring.
Animal sound classification using MFCC features and RandomForest. 13 classes of animal audio classification.
A deep learning-based system for identifying animal sounds using 1D CNN and MFCCs. Helps in wildlife monitoring by classifying bird and mammal calls from audio recordings.
Sistema desarrollado en EXPO para clasificar 6 clases de animales por sus sonidos con el modelo YAMNET. (Animal sound classification system using YAMNET for 6 animal classes.)
Animal language detection project using audio processing and machine learning techniques.
Enhancing environmental sound classification via Mel-spectrograms and MFCC audio preprocessing techniques applied to Urbansound8k and ESC-50 datasets. Includes dog_bark classification.

Deep learning project for detecting overlapping sound events using CNNs. Uses Librosa for MFCC/spectrogram extraction, supports multi-label classification on UrbanSound8K and ESC-50 environmental sound datasets.
